hero.title: Hallimane: Bangalore's Authentic Village Culinary Journey
hero.subtitle: For over two decades, Hallimane Restaurant has been a landmark, inviting you to savour the best of fresh, hygienic, and delicious rural cuisine in a truly immersive village ambience.

about.title: The Enduring Legacy of Hallimane
about.paragraph1: For well over 20 years, **Hallimane Restaurant** has carved its indelible mark on Bangalore's culinary map. Located in a vintage part of the city, we offer an escape to a serene village ambience, meticulously crafted with traditional tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings, and an abundance of lush plants. Our unique commitment to delivering the best ethnic and value-for-money dining experience has been widely celebrated and proclaimed by the media across Bangalore.
about.paragraph2: **Hallimane** stands as a cherished destination for Bangaloreans and visitors alike, those who yearn to savour the authentic taste of rural cuisine within a genuine rural setting. Every dish we proudly serve embodies freshness, hygiene, and delicious flavour, all meticulously prepared and complemented by the exemplary service that defines our enduring legacy. Join us to reconnect with tradition through an unparalleled culinary journey.
